s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive, ulcerative, purpuric skin lesion with multifocal peripheral patches, papules, and macules
salient_findings: Enlarging purpuric patch on the left lateral superior forehead and left anterior scalp
Central ulceration and bleeding of the lesion
Multifocal peripheral reddish-purple patches, papules, and macules
key_facts: Lesion first developed in March 2014
Rapid growth and extension of the lesion in June 2014
Lesion size: 30 × 25-cm
Location of the lesion: left anterior scalp, left parietal scalp, left forehead, left lateral cheek, right frontal scalp, and right parietal scalp
No evidence of lymphadenopathy
Dermis permeated by irregular, slitlike spaces containing erythrocytes
Cells had pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and hyperchromatic nuclei
Cells stained positively with CD31 and were negative for CK5
Strong immunopositivity for ADRB1, ADRB2, and ADRB3 receptors

shortlist.label: Angiosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Rapid growth and ulceration of the purpuric lesion, strong immunopositivity for ADRB1, ADRB2, and ADRB3 receptors

shortlist.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Purpuric patches, papules, and macules, presence of slitlike spaces containing erythrocytes in the dermis

shortlist.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Multifocal peripheral patches, papules, and macules, cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and hyperchromatic nuclei

shortlist.label: Cutaneous B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Similar presentation to cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, but with different immunophenotype

shortlist.label: Leukemia cutis
shortlist.why_kept: Involvement of the skin with a hematologic malignancy, presence of cells with hyperchromatic nuclei

shortlist.label: Mycosis fungoides
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive, ulcerative skin lesion with multifocal patches, papules, and macules

shortlist.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
shortlist.why_kept: Purpuric skin lesions, presence of irregular, slitlike spaces in the dermis

shortlist.label: Granuloma faciale
shortlist.why_kept: Purpuric patches and papules on the face, presence of cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
